note: Two things get measured per query: did the Skill tool fire for pixeltamer (trigger), and once it did, was a reference or recipe file actually read (routing). A skill that triggers but skips its own doctrine is only half working. Cases with a `scaffold` path need that file present; the runner creates it.

cases.query: draw me an app icon for a habit tracker, 1024x1024, transparent background, save it to /tmp/icon.png
make a LinkedIn scroll-stop card with the headline 'We deleted 40% of our codebase' — square, bold type
I need a dashboard mockup for an analytics SaaS, dark UI, showing real revenue numbers not lorem ipsum
generate a magazine cover for a podcast about failed startups, portrait, with a masthead
take ~/Pictures/hero.png and change ONLY the sky to overcast, keep everything else identical
blend these two references into one shot — the product from a.png on the kitchen counter from b.png, morning light
build me an infographic explaining the four stages of our onboarding funnel, portrait, cream and navy
I need a product hero shot of a ceramic coffee mug, studio lighting, for the landing page
cut out the background on the logo at /tmp/pixeltamer-eval/logo.png so it works on a dark header
cases.why: Tests whether 'cut out the background' phrasing reaches us at all. Needs the file to exist — without it the agent spends every turn searching and never reaches a tool decision, which scores as a trigger miss for the wrong reason.

cases.query: we need a Meta ad creative — hook text over the product, square, punchy
my OPENAI_API_KEY returns 401 on chat completions, is the key expired?
describe what's in this screenshot in two sentences
OCR the text out of this receipt photo at ~/Downloads/receipt.jpg
compress every PNG under ./out/ to below 100KB, use oxipng
build me a README banner with our exact brand hex codes and the repo name — needs to match our other repos byte for byte
cases.why: Deterministic, part of a matching set, will be revised repeatedly. This is the HTML-render path, not the generate path. If pixeltamer fires here the description is over-broad.

cases.query: write the alt text for the twelve images in this blog post
convert all the JPEGs in this folder to WebP at 80% quality
the CSS gradient on our hero section looks banded in Safari, can you fix it
generate a video intro for our YouTube channel, 10 seconds, animated logo
cases.why: gpt-image-2 is images only. Firing here means promising something we can't deliver.

cases.query: what image dimensions should I use for an Open Graph card?
cases.why: A question about images, not a request to make one. Classic near-miss.
